blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Bioenergetics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
Bioenergetics and ATP: the energy currency of cells

blocks.prompt:
1 Define bioenergetics. Name the two processes that help to understand its principles.
(Bioenergetics ki definition likhein. Woh do processes batayein jo is ke usool samajhne mein madad dete hain.)
blocks.explanation: Bioenergetics zinda nizamon mein energy ke bahao ka mutaala hai, yani cells energy kaise jama aur kharch karte hain. Photosynthesis (energy pakarne wala) aur respiration (energy kharij karne wala) is ke usool samjhate hain.

book_ref.quote: It explores the processes through which cells store and expend energy

blocks.text: ATP: The Energy Currency of Cells

blocks.prompt:
2 Name the three subunits of an ATP molecule.
(ATP molecule ke teen hisson ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Adenine, nitrogen wali base
2. Ribose, paanch carbon wali sugar
3. Teen phosphate groups

book_ref.quote: A molecule of ATP has three subunits i.e. adenine

blocks.prompt:
3 What are high-energy bonds of ATP? How much energy is released when one is broken?
(ATP ke high-energy bonds kya hain? Aik bond tootne se kitni energy nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: ATP ke do phosphate groups ke darmiyan covalent bonds high-energy bonds hain. Aik bond tootne se inorganic phosphate (Pi) alag hota hai aur ATP ke har mole se taqreeban 7.3 kcal (7,300 calories) energy nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: The covalent bonds between two phosphates are high-energy bonds

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is ATP called the energy currency of the cell?
(ATP ko cell ki energy currency kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cells khurak ki oxidation se mili energy ADP aur Pi jor kar ATP mein rakhte hain aur zaroorat par ATP torte hain. ATP energy dene wale kaamon mein banta aur energy lene wale kaamon mein toot-ta hai, is tarah yeh currency ki tarah reactions ke darmiyan energy muntaqil karta hai.

book_ref.quote: In this way ATP transfers energy between metabolic reactions

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between ADP and AMP.
(ADP aur AMP mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: ADP, ATP se aik Pi nikalne par banta hai; AMP, ADP se mazeed aik Pi nikalne par.

book_ref.quote: When this happens, ATP becomes ADP (adenosine diphosphate) and one Pi is released

rows: Adenosine diphosphate
Adenosine monophosphate
ATP ka bahar wala P-P bond tootne aur aik Pi alag hone se banta hai
Kuch soorton mein ADP mazeed tootne aur Pi alag hone se banta hai
ATP + H₂O → ADP + Pi + energy (7.3 kcal/mole)
ADP + H₂O → AMP + Pi + energy (7.3 kcal/mole)

blocks.prompt:
6 Water is shown on both sides of the photosynthesis equation. Is there any net yield of water?
(Photosynthesis ki equation mein pani dono taraf hai. Kya pani ka koi net hasil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Pani kuch reactions mein reactant (12H₂O) aur kuch mein product (6H₂O) hai, is liye dono taraf hai, lekin pani ka koi net hasil nahi.

book_ref.quote: However, there is no net yield of water

blocks.prompt:
7 Define photosynthesis in terms of energy-poor and energy-rich compounds.
(Photosynthesis ki definition energy-poor aur energy-rich compounds ke hawale se likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis woh amal hai jis mein carbon ke energy-poor inorganic compounds (CO₂) energy-rich carbohydrates mein reduce hote hain; is ke liye photosynthetic pigments roshni ki energy jazb kar ke chemical energy banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Photosynthesis is the process in which the energy-poor inorganic compounds of carbon

blocks.prompt:
8 What is compensation point?
(Compensation point kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Subah aur shaam kam roshni mein photosynthesis aur respiration ki rate thori der barabar ho sakti hai. Photosynthesis ki oxygen respiration ki zaroorat ke barabar aur respiration ki CO₂ photosynthesis ki zaroorat ke barabar hoti hai. Pattiyon aur hawa ke darmiyan gas ke net tabadle ke na hone ka yeh lamha compensation point hai.

book_ref.quote: At this moment there is no net gas exchange between leaves and atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
9 Why do leaves release CO₂ in darkness but release O₂ at noon?
(Pattiyan andhere mein CO₂ kyun chhorti hain lekin dopehar ko O₂ kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis sirf din mein hota hai jab ke respiration din raat chalti hai. Andhere mein pattiyan sirf respire karti hain, O₂ leti aur CO₂ chhorti hain. Dopehar ko photosynthesis tez hota hai: respiration zaroori CO₂ nahi de sakti aur O₂ zaroorat se zyada banti hai, is liye O₂ ka net ikhraj aur CO₂ ka jazb hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Photosynthesis occurs only during day time but respiration goes on day and night

blocks.prompt:
10 Give two roles of water in photosynthesis.
(Photosynthesis mein pani ke do kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Pani CO₂ ki reduction ke liye hydrogen ka zariya hai (yeh hydrogen NADP ko NADPH banati hai).
2. Photosynthesis ki oxygen pani se aati hai, is liye pani fazai oxygen ka aham zariya hai jo aerobic respiration ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: so water is an important source of atmospheric oxygen

blocks.prompt:
11 State van Niel's hypothesis. When was it confirmed?
(Van Niel ka mafrooza bayan karein. Is ki tasdeeq kab hui?)
blocks.explanation: 1930s mein C. B. van Niel ne kaha ke plant hydrogen ke liye pani torta hai aur oxygen zimni product ke taur par nikalti hai. 1940s mein scientists ne ¹⁸O isotope ko tracer bana kar is ki tasdeeq ki.

book_ref.quote: Neil’s hypothesis was later confirmed by scientists during 1940s

blocks.prompt:
12 What is meant by 'reducing power' in photosynthesis?
(Photosynthesis mein 'reducing power' se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis mein pani toot kar hydrogen deta hai jo coenzyme NADP (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate) ko NADPH banati hai. Yahi NADPH 'reducing power' hai jo CO₂ ko sugar mein reduce karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The reduced coenzyme i.e., NADPH serves as the “reducing power”

blocks.prompt:
13 What are photons? What happens when a pigment molecule absorbs a photon?
(Photons kya hain? Jab pigment molecule photon jazb kare to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni photons naam ke zarraat ki lehar ki tarah hai. Pigment molecule aik waqt mein aik photon jazb karta hai; us ke electrons oonchi energy level par chale jate hain aur molecule excited ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Pigment molecules absorb one photon at a time

blocks.prompt:
14 Which photons carry more energy, blue or red? What is the effect on electrons?
(Kaun se photons mein zyada energy hai, blue ya red? Electrons par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhoti wavelength wale (blue) photons mein lambi wavelength wale (red) photons se zyada energy hoti hai. Zyada energy wale photons electrons ko zyada oonchi energy level par le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: More energetic photons (shorter wavelength) promote electrons to higher energy levels

blocks.prompt:
15 Name the two parts of a chlorophyll molecule and give the role of each.
(Chlorophyll molecule ke do hisson ke naam aur har aik ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hydrophilic head (paani pasand sar): chaar pyrrole rings ka porphyrin ring jin ke darmiyan magnesium atom hai; yeh roshni jazb karta hai.
2. Hydrophobic tail (paani na-pasand dum): lambi hydrocarbon chain; yeh molecule ko thylakoid membrane mein jamati hai.

book_ref.quote: A molecule of chlorophyll consists of two parts i.e., a hydrophilic head and a hydrophobic tail

blocks.prompt:
16 What are pyrrole rings? How are they held in chlorophyll?
(Pyrrole rings kya hain? Chlorophyll mein yeh kaise jure hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pyrrole rings paanch kono wale nitrogen wale compounds hain. Chaar pyrrole rings chlorophyll ke head ka porphyrin ring banate hain aur darmiyan mein magnesium atom unhein jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: which further consists of four pyrrole rings (5-sided N-containing compounds)

blocks.prompt:
17 Why do leaves look green?
(Pattiyan sabz kyun nazar aati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorophylls zyada tar violet-blue aur orange-red roshni jazb karte hain. Green roshni sab se kam jazb hoti hai aur guzar jati ya palat jati hai, is liye pattiyan sabz nazar aati hain.

book_ref.quote: Chlorophylls absorb mainly violet-blue and orange-red wavelengths of light

blocks.prompt:
18 Write the dual role of carotenoids in photosynthesis.
(Photosynthesis mein carotenoids ka dohra kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh spectrum ke blue aur green hisse ki roshni ki energy pakarte hain.
2. Yeh photosynthetic nizam ko zyada roshni ke nuqsan se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: They capture light energy in the blue and green regions of the spectrum

blocks.prompt:
19 What are accessory pigments? Give examples.
(Accessory pigments kya hain? Misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Chlorophyll a ke ilawa woh tamam pigments jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni jama kar ke energy chlorophyll a ki taraf dete hain accessory pigments hain. Misalein: chlorophyll b, carotenoids (carotenes aur xanthophylls) aur phycobilins.

book_ref.quote: which can gather light for photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
20 Where are chlorophyll b, carotenoids and phycobilins found?
(Chlorophyll b, carotenoids aur phycobilins kahan paye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorophyll b aur carotenoids plants mein jab ke phycobilins red algae aur cyanobacteria mein paye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Chlorophyll b and carotenoids are found in plants

blocks.prompt:
21 What is an absorption spectrum? At which wavelengths do chlorophylls absorb maximum light?
(Absorption spectrum kya hai? Chlorophylls kin wavelengths par sab se zyada roshni jazb karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi pigment ki jazb ki hui mukhtalif wavelengths dikhane wala graph us ka absorption spectrum hai. Chlorophylls blue (430 nm) aur red (670 nm) roshni sab se zyada jazb karte hain.

book_ref.quote: A graph showing different wavelengths absorbed by a pigment

blocks.prompt:
22 What does the matching of the action spectrum with the absorption spectrum show?
(Action spectrum aur absorption spectrum ke milne se kya pata chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Action spectrum batata hai ke blue aur red roshni photosynthesis ke liye sab se mo'assar hai, aur yahi chlorophylls sab se zyada jazb karte hain. Is liye photosynthesis ka action spectrum pigments ke absorption spectrum se milta hai, yani pigments ki jazb ki hui roshni hi photosynthesis chalati hai.

book_ref.quote: This means that the action spectrum of photosynthesis coincides with the absorption spectrum

blocks.prompt:
23 How is an action spectrum obtained?
(Action spectrum kaise hasil kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plant par aik aik kar ke mukhtalif rangon ki roshni dali jati hai. Har rang par pattiyon se nikalne wali oxygen naap kar photosynthesis ki rate maloom ki jati hai. Is data ka graph action spectrum hai.

book_ref.quote: The effectiveness of different wavelengths of light is determined in terms of action spectrum

blocks.prompt:
24 What did Engelmann observe in Spirogyra in 1883?
(Engelmann ne 1883 mein Spirogyra mein kya dekha?)
blocks.explanation: T. W. Engelmann ne Spirogyra filament ke cells par mukhtalif wavelengths dalin. Blue aur red roshni wale cells mein sab se zyada photosynthesis aur sab se zyada oxygen nikli. Yeh pehla action spectrum tha.

book_ref.quote: When the cells of a filament of Spirogyra were illuminated with different wavelengths of light

blocks.prompt:
25 How efficiently do plants convert solar energy into chemical energy?
(Plants solar energy ko chemical energy mein kitni karkardagi se badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Plants mili hui solar energy ka sirf taqreeban 1-2% chemical energy mein badalte hain. Yeh kam lagta hai magar zameen par taqreeban sari zindagi ke liye kaafi hai.

book_ref.quote: Despite this seemingly low efficiency, this conversion is enough to sustain almost all life on Earth

blocks.prompt:
26 How does CO₂ reach the mesophyll cells of a leaf?
(CO₂ patti ke mesophyll cells tak kaise pahunchti hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ stomata (jo pattiyon mein bari tadaad mein hain) se andar aati hai aur mesophyll cells ki cell walls ke jazb kiye hue pani mein hal ho jati hai. Is ka dakhla stomata ke khulne par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Carbon dioxide enters the leaves through stomata and gets dissolved in water

blocks.prompt:
27 Compare the carbon sources of aquatic and land photosynthetic organisms.
(Aabi aur khushki ke photosynthetic ajsam ke carbon ke zariye ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aabi ajsam pani mein hal carbon ke zariye aur khushki wale hawa ki CO₂ istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Land photosynthetic organisms use atmospheric CO₂ as carbon source

rows: Pani mein hal shuda CO₂ istemal karte hain
Hawa ki CO₂ istemal karte hain
Bicarbonates aur soluble carbonates bhi istemal karte hain
CO₂ stomata se pattiyon mein dakhil hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
28 On which organisms was van Niel's hypothesis based?
(Van Niel ka mafrooza kin jandaron ki tehqeeq par mabni tha?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh photosynthetic bacteria ki tehqeeq par mabni tha jo carbon dioxide se carbohydrate banate hain magar oxygen nahi chhorte.

book_ref.quote: Neil’s hypothesis was based on the investigations on photosynthetic bacteria

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between antenna complex and reaction centre of a photosystem.
(Photosystem ke antenna complex aur reaction centre mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Antenna complex roshni jama karta hai; reaction centre high-energy electrons aage deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Antenna complex has many pigment molecules which capture light energy

rows: Photosystem ka roshni jama karne wala hissa
Photosystem ka markazi hissa
Is mein bohat se pigment molecules hote hain
Is mein chlorophyll a ke aik ya zyada molecules hote hain
Roshni pakar kar excitation energy reaction centre ko deta hai
High-energy electrons primary electron acceptor ko deta hai

blocks.prompt:
30 Differentiate between PS-I and PS-II on the basis of their reaction centres.
(PS-I aur PS-II mein un ke reaction centres ki bunyad par farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: PS-I ke reaction centre mein P700 aur PS-II mein P680 chlorophyll a hai.

book_ref.quote: The reaction centre of PS-II has P680 chlorophyll-a, which absorbs best the light of 680 nm

rows: Reaction centre mein P700 chlorophyll a
Reaction centre mein P680 chlorophyll a
700 nm ki roshni sab se zyada jazb karta hai
680 nm ki roshni behtareen jazb karta hai
Pehle daryaft hua, is liye I
Baad mein daryaft hua, is liye II

blocks.prompt:
31 Name the three key events of the light-dependent reactions.
(Light-dependent reactions ke teen aham waqiaat ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Photosynthetic pigments ka roshni ki energy jazb karna
2. Is energy se electrons ka excite hona
3. ATP aur NADPH ka banna

book_ref.quote: the absorption of light energy by photosynthetic pigments, (2) the excitation of electrons by that energy

blocks.prompt:
32 Name the reducing and assimilating powers formed in the light-dependent reactions. Where are they used?
(Light-dependent reactions mein banne wali reducing aur assimilating powers ke naam likhein. Yeh kahan istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni ki energy chemical energy mein badal kar reducing aur assimilating powers, NADPH aur ATP, banti hai. Light-independent reactions inhein CO₂ ki reduction ke liye istemal kar ke energy C-H bonds mein jama karti hain.

book_ref.quote: which is in the form of reducing and assimilating powers i.e., NADPH and ATP

blocks.prompt:
33 What is photolysis? Write its products.
(Photolysis kya hai? Is ke products likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Photolysis photosynthesis mein pani torne ka qadam hai. Pani PS-II ke oxidized chlorophyll se mil kar do hydrogen ions, aik oxygen atom (jo doosre se mil kar O₂ banata hai) aur do electrons mein toot-ta hai. Electrons P680 ka 'hole' bharte hain.

book_ref.quote: These two electrons fill the “hole” in P680 chlorophyll

blocks.prompt:
34 How is NADPH formed in the light-dependent reactions?
(Light-dependent reactions mein NADPH kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: PS-I ka primary electron acceptor excited electrons ferredoxin (FD) ko deta hai. NADP reductase enzyme inhein FD se NADP⁺ ko deta hai. NADP⁺ do electrons aur aik H⁺ le kar NADPH ban jata hai aur high-energy electrons is mein jama ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: When NADP⁺ gets two electrons and an H⁺ ion, it is reduced to NADPH

blocks.prompt:
35 What is Z-scheme?
(Z-scheme kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Non-cyclic photophosphorylation mein electrons PS-II, PS-I aur electron transport chains se zigzag raste par chalte hain. Is zigzag raste ko Z-scheme kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: electron transport chains, is called Z-scheme

blocks.prompt:
36 Compare non-cyclic and cyclic photophosphorylation.
(Non-cyclic aur cyclic photophosphorylation ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Non-cyclic mein dono photosystems aur ATP, NADPH, O₂ bante hain; cyclic mein sirf PS-I aur sirf ATP.

book_ref.quote: It is the usual way of the production of ATPs during light-dependent reactions

rows: Light-dependent reactions mein ATP banane ka aam tareeqa
Jab Calvin cycle sust ho aur NADPH jama ho jaye
PS-I aur PS-II dono hissa lete hain
Sirf PS-I, PS-II nahi
Electrons NADPH mein jate hain
Electrons wapas P700 chlorophyll par aate hain
ATP, NADPH aur O₂ bante hain
Sirf ATP; NADPH aur O₂ nahi

blocks.prompt:
37 How is the H⁺ gradient built up in the thylakoid?
(Thylakoid mein H⁺ gradient kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electron transport chain mein carrier se carrier jate hue electrons energy khote hain. Yeh energy H⁺ ions ko stroma se lumen mein active transport par kharch hoti hai, is tarah lumen mein bohat se H⁺ jama ho jate hain. Is H⁺ gradient mein potential energy hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This H⁺ ion gradient in lumen has potential energy

blocks.prompt:
38 What is the role of ATP synthase in the chloroplast?
(Chloroplast mein ATP synthase ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: H⁺ ions lumen se stroma mein ATP synthase (thylakoid membrane ka protein) ke zariye wapas aate hain. Yeh enzyme is H⁺ bahao ki energy se ADP ko inorganic phosphate (Pi) se jor kar ATP banata hai.

book_ref.quote: This enzyme uses the energy yielded from the flow of H⁺ ions to make a bond between ADP and inorganic phosphate

blocks.prompt:
39 What do the light-independent reactions take from CO₂, ATP and NADPH?
(Light-independent reactions CO₂, ATP aur NADPH se kya leti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh stroma mein CO₂ se carbon, ATP se energy aur NADPH se hydrogen ions le kar energy-rich sugar molecules banati hain.

book_ref.quote: These reactions use carbon from CO₂, energy from ATP, and hydrogen ions from NADPH

blocks.prompt:
40 Why are the dark reactions called the Calvin cycle?
(Dark reactions ko Calvin cycle kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ki tafseel Melvin Calvin aur un ke saathiyon ne University of California mein daryaft ki, is liye inhein Calvin cycle kehte hain. Calvin ko is kaam par 1961 mein Nobel Prize mila.

book_ref.quote: That is why, the dark reactions are also called the Calvin cycle

blocks.prompt:
41 Name the three phases of the Calvin cycle.
(Calvin cycle ke teen phases ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Carbon fixation (carbon ko jorna)
2. Reduction
3. RuBP ki regeneration (dobara banna)

book_ref.quote: The Calvin cycle is divided into the following phases

blocks.prompt:
42 What is formed when rubisco combines three CO₂ with three RuBP?
(Jab rubisco teen CO₂ ko teen RuBP se jorta hai to kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen carbon wale compound 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ke chhe molecules bante hain. Pehla product teen carbon wala hai is liye Calvin cycle ko C-3 pathway kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: It results in the formation of six molecules of a three–carbon compound called 3–phosphoglyceric acid

blocks.prompt:
43 What happens to the G3P that leaves the Calvin cycle?
(Calvin cycle se bahar jane wale G3P ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhe G3P mein se aik cycle se bahar jata hai. Yeh doosre G3P se mil kar glucose banata hai jo phir doosre carbohydrates mein badal sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: It combines with another G3P and makes glucose

blocks.prompt:
44 How is RuBP regenerated in the Calvin cycle?
(Calvin cycle mein RuBP dobara kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kai reactions ke zariye paanch G3P teen ribulose phosphate (RuP) bante hain. Light reactions ke teen ATP se har RuP par aik phosphate lag kar teen RuBP bante hain jo dobara CO₂ lete hain.

book_ref.quote: One phosphate group is added to each RuP to make three molecules of RuBP by using three ATPs

blocks.prompt:
45 Define cellular respiration and write its summary equation.
(Cellular respiration ki definition aur khulasa equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cellular respiration woh aalmi amal hai jis se jandar carbon wale pechida compounds (maslan glucose) tor kar qabil-e-istemal energy lete hain, cells mein khurak ki qadam ba qadam oxidation se.
C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + Energy

book_ref.quote: Cellular respiration is the universal process by which organisms break down complex carbon containing compounds

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between external respiration and cellular respiration.
(External respiration aur cellular respiration mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: External respiration mahol se gas ka tabadla hai; cellular respiration cells ke andar khurak ki oxidation hai.

book_ref.quote: Cellular respiration is the process by which energy is made available to cells

rows: Ise breathing (saans lena) bhi kehte hain
Cells ke andar hoti hai
Jism aur mahol ke darmiyan CO₂ aur O₂ ka tabadla
Cells mein khurak ki qadam ba qadam oxidation jis se energy milti hai

blocks.prompt:
47 Name the two main types of cellular respiration. Which step is common to both?
(Cellular respiration ki do bari qismon ke naam likhein. Dono mein kaun sa qadam mushtarik hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Anaerobic respiration (fermentation), oxygen ki ghair maujoodgi mein
2. Aerobic respiration, oxygen ki maujoodgi mein
Dono ke pehle qadam mein glycolysis se glucose do pyruvic acid (C₃H₄O₃) mein toot-ti hai.

book_ref.quote: Anaerobic respiration (fermentation) takes place in the absence of oxygen

blocks.prompt:
48 Why does anaerobic respiration yield little energy?
(Anaerobic respiration se kam energy kyun milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anaerobic respiration mein glucose poori tarah oxidize nahi hoti. Aik glucose se sirf do ATP milte hain, jo glucose ki energy ka taqreeban 2% (14.6 kcal ke barabar) hai.

book_ref.quote: In anaerobic respiration, glucose is not completely oxidized

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between alcoholic fermentation and lactic acid fermentation.
(Alcoholic fermentation aur lactic acid fermentation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Alcoholic fermentation se ethyl alcohol aur CO₂; lactic acid fermentation se sirf lactic acid.

book_ref.quote: Lactic acid fermentation releases no carbon dioxide

rows: Pyruvic acid se ethyl alcohol (C₂H₅OH) aur CO₂ banti hai
Pyruvic acid se lactic acid (C₃H₆O₃); CO₂ nahi nikalti
2(C₃H₄O₃) + 4H → 2(C₂H₅OH) + 2CO₂
2(C₃H₄O₃) + 4H → 2(C₃H₆O₃)
Kuch bacteria aur yeast mein
Insanon aur janwaron ke muscle cells aur bohat se bacteria mein

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ne in dono fermentations ki equations aapas mein badal kar chhapi hain aur lactic acid ka formula C₂H₆O₃ likha hai. Sahi: alcoholic fermentation mein ethyl alcohol aur CO₂, lactic acid fermentation mein sirf lactic acid (C₃H₆O₃), CO₂ nahi. Dono mein 4H do NADH se aate hain.

blocks.prompt:
50 Why does lactic acid form in human muscles?
(Insani muscles mein lactic acid kyun banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sakht jismani mehnat mein oxygen muscle cells tak zaroorat ke mutabiq tezi se nahi pahunchti. Tab cells lactic acid fermentation karte hain aur pyruvic acid lactic acid ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It happens during extreme physical activities, when oxygen cannot be transported to the cells

blocks.prompt:
51 Name the four stages of aerobic respiration with their sites.
(Aerobic respiration ke chaar stages ke naam un ki jagah ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Glycolysis: cytosol
2. Pyruvic acid oxidation: mitochondria
3. Krebs cycle (citric acid cycle): mitochondria
4. Electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis: mitochondria (andar wali membrane)

book_ref.quote: Cellular respiration is a continuous process, but for study purposes we can divide it into four main stages

blocks.prompt:
52 Name the two phases of glycolysis and state the main event of each.
(Glycolysis ke do phases ke naam aur har aik ka asal waqia likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Preparatory phase: energy (2 ATP) kharch hoti hai aur glucose do G3P mein toot-ti hai.
2. Oxidative phase: G3P se hydrogen nikalti hai aur nikalne wali energy ATP mein pack hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Glucose 6-phosphate is converted into its isomer called fructose 6-phosphate

blocks.prompt:
53 Besides enzymes, which substances are essential for glycolysis? Where are its enzymes found?
(Enzymes ke ilawa glycolysis ke liye kaun se maadde zaroori hain? Is ke enzymes kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes ke ilawa ATP aur coenzyme NAD⁺ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) zaroori hain. Glycolysis ke tamam enzymes cytosol mein hal shuda hote hain.

book_ref.quote: In addition to the enzymes, ATP and coenzyme NAD⁺ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) are also essential

blocks.prompt:
54 What is gluconeogenesis?
(Gluconeogenesis kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycolysis ko ulta chala kar pyruvic acid ko wapas glucose banaya ja sakta hai. Ise gluconeogenesis kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Pyruvic acid can also be turned back into glucose by reversing glycolysis

blocks.prompt:
55 How does glucose enter cells?
(Glucose cells mein kaise dakhil hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose tissue fluid se cells mein passive transport se aik khaas glucose carrier ke zariye dakhil hoti hai. Yeh carrier insulin jaise hormones se control (gated) ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: This carrier can be controlled (gated) by hormones such as insulin

blocks.prompt:
56 What is acetyl-CoA? How is it formed?
(Acetyl-CoA kya hai? Yeh kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acetyl-CoA pyruvic acid oxidation ka product hai jo Krebs cycle mein dakhil hota hai. Pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikal kar acetaldehyde banta hai jo oxidize ho kar (NAD⁺ → NADH) acetyl group banta hai; acetyl group coenzyme A se mil kar acetyl-CoA banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Acetyl group combines with coenzyme-A (CoA) to form acetyl-CoA

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is it not correct to say that respiration turns oxygen into carbon dioxide?
(Yeh kehna kyun durust nahi ke respiration oxygen ko carbon dioxide mein badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon dioxide (pyruvic acid oxidation aur Krebs cycle mein) oxygen ke shamil hone se pehle nikal jati hai. Oxygen sirf electron transport chain ke aakhir mein istemal ho kar pani banati hai. Is liye respiration glucose ko CO₂ aur oxygen ko pani mein badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is more correct to say that respiration turns glucose into carbon dioxide, and oxygen into water

blocks.prompt:
58 What is oxidative decarboxylation? Give one example from the Krebs cycle.
(Oxidative decarboxylation kya hai? Krebs cycle se aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Oxidative decarboxylation mein molecule se aik CO₂ nikalti hai aur woh oxidize hota hai (aik NAD⁺, NADH banta hai). Misaal: citric acid (6-C) alpha-ketoglutaric acid (5-C) ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Citric acid undergoes an oxidative decarboxylation reaction

blocks.prompt:
59 At which step of the Krebs cycle is ATP made directly?
(Krebs cycle ke kis qadam par ATP seedha banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Succinyl CoA mein succinic acid aur CoA ke darmiyan bond high-energy hai. Jab succinyl CoA, CoA aur succinic acid mein toot-ta hai to nikalne wali energy se aik ATP banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The bond between succinic acid and CoA is a high-energy linkage

blocks.prompt:
60 Why is the Krebs cycle called a cycle?
(Krebs cycle ko cycle kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke pehle qadam mein oxaloacetic acid acetyl group se milta hai aur aakhri qadam (malic acid ki oxidation) mein oxaloacetic acid dobara banta hai jo agle acetyl CoA se mil sakta hai. Is tarah reactions cycle ki tarah dohrayi jati hain.

book_ref.quote: This completes the cycle and oxaloacetic acid is now free to bind another molecule of acetyl CoA

blocks.prompt:
61 Write the sequence of electron carriers in the respiratory electron transport chain.
(Respiratory electron transport chain mein electron carriers ki tarteeb likhein.)
blocks.explanation: NADH (ya FADH₂) → coenzyme Q → cytochrome b → cytochrome c → cytochrome a complex → oxygen

book_ref.quote: The reduced CoQ transports electrons to cytochrome ‘b’

blocks.prompt:
62 How is water formed at the end of the respiratory electron transport chain?
(Respiratory electron transport chain ke aakhir mein pani kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cytochrome a complex electrons chain ke aakhri sire par oxygen atom ko deta hai. Oxygen atom do electrons aur do hydrogen ions le kar pani banata hai.

book_ref.quote: At the end, the two hydrogen ions are taken by the oxygen atom which has also taken two electrons to form water

blocks.prompt:
63 What is phosphorylation? Name the two ways by which a cell does it.
(Phosphorylation kya hai? Cell ise kin do tareeqon se karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
ADP mein phosphate group jor kar ATP banana phosphorylation hai. Cell yeh do tareeqon se karta hai:
1. Chemiosmotic phosphorylation (chemiosmosis)
2. Substrate-level phosphorylation

book_ref.quote: Cells generate ATP by phosphorylation i.e. adding a phosphate group to ADP

blocks.prompt:
64 How many ATP are obtained from one NADH of the Krebs cycle, one NADH of glycolysis and one FADH₂?
(Krebs cycle ke aik NADH, glycolysis ke aik NADH aur aik FADH₂ se kitne ATP milte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Krebs cycle ka NADH: 3 ATP
2. Glycolysis ka NADH: 2 ATP (mitochondrial membrane ke paar le jane mein aik ATP kharch hota hai)
3. FADH₂: 2 ATP

book_ref.quote: Each FADH₂ molecule leads to the production of two ATP molecules

blocks.prompt:
65 Aerobic oxidation is said to be 18 times more efficient than anaerobic. Explain.
(Kaha jata hai ke aerobic oxidation anaerobic se 18 guna zyada efficient hai. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik glucose ki aerobic oxidation se net 36 ATP milte hain jab ke anaerobic (sirf glycolysis) se sirf 2 ATP. 36 ÷ 2 = 18, is liye aerobic 18 guna zyada efficient hai.

book_ref.quote: While during the glycolysis of anaerobic oxidation only 2 ATP molecules are generated

blocks.prompt:
66 Name the food substances other than glucose that we consume as respiratory fuel.
(Glucose ke ilawa woh khurak ke maadde batayein jo hum respiratory fuel ke taur par khate hain.)
blocks.explanation: Hamari khurak mein free glucose aam nahi. Hum sucrose aur doosre disaccharides, starch, fats aur proteins khate hain. Proteins amino acids mein digest ho kar, aur fats glycerol aur fatty acids mein toot kar istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Free glucose molecules are not common in our diet

blocks.prompt:
67 What is photorespiration? How does it differ from aerobic respiration in its product?
(Photorespiration kya hai? Apne product mein yeh aerobic respiration se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni ki maujoodgi mein sabz cells ki woh respiratory activity jis se CO₂ nikalti hai photorespiration hai. Aerobic respiration ki tarah yeh oxygen leti aur CO₂ aur H₂O deti hai, magar is mein ATP nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: The respiratory activity that occurs in green cells in the presence of light resulting in release of carbon dioxide

blocks.prompt:
68 Under what condition does rubisco add O₂ instead of CO₂ to RuBP?
(Kis halat mein rubisco RuBP mein CO₂ ki bajaye O₂ milata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab patti ke cells mein CO₂ ki nisbati miqdaar kam aur oxygen zyada ho jaye to rubisco RuBP mein O₂ milata hai. Tab RuBP aik phosphoglycerate aur aik phosphoglycolate mein toot-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: However, when the relative concentration of CO₂ decreases and there is more oxygen in leaf cells

blocks.prompt:
69 Name the three organelles involved in photorespiration.
(Photorespiration mein shamil teen organelles ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Chloroplast: phosphoglycolate banta aur glycolate mein badalta hai; glycerate wapas phosphoglycerate banta hai.
2. Peroxisome: glycolate se glyoxylate (H₂O₂ ke saath) aur glycine; serine se glycerate.
3. Mitochondrion: do glycine se aik serine.

book_ref.quote: Phosphoglycolate is converted into glycolate, which moves from chloroplast to peroxisome

blocks.prompt:
70 What are C-3 plants? How does photorespiration affect them?
(C-3 plants kya hain? Photorespiration in par kya asar dalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jo plants sirf Calvin cycle se carbon fix karte hain C-3 plants hain. Jab in mein photorespiration hoti hai to yeh apne fix kiye carbon ka 25% se 50% kho dete hain aur paidawar kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Plants that use Calvin cycle to fix carbon are called C-3 plants

blocks.prompt:
71 Why was there little or no photorespiration when photosynthesis first evolved?
(Jab photosynthesis pehli baar wujood mein aaya to photorespiration kam ya na hone ke barabar kyun thi?)
blocks.explanation: Us waqt fiza mein oxygen bohat kam thi, is liye O₂ rubisco ke liye CO₂ se muqabla nahi karti thi. Lakhon saal baad free O₂ jama hui aur rubisco ki aik hi active site ke liye muqabla shuru hua, jis se photorespiration paida hui.

book_ref.quote: When photosynthesis first evolved, there was little oxygen in the atmosphere

blocks.text: Adaptations to the problems of Photorespiration

blocks.prompt:
72 Write two features of the leaves of C-4 plants.
(C-4 plants ki pattiyon ki do khususiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Mesophyll cells mein hawa ki jagahen kam hoti hain.
2. Calvin cycle ke enzymes zyada tar khaas bundle-sheath cells mein hote hain jo CO₂ ke liye na-guzar (impermeable) hain.

book_ref.quote: In their leaves, the mesophyll cells have less air spaces

blocks.prompt:
73 C-4 photosynthesis costs almost double energy. Why is it still useful in hot climates?
(C-4 photosynthesis mein taqreeban dugni energy lagti hai. Phir bhi garam mumalik mein yeh mufeed kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garam mumalik mein warna photorespiration fix kiye carbon ka aadhe se zyada hissa zaya kar deti. C-4 plants bundle-sheath cells mein CO₂ zyada rakhte hain is liye photorespiration ki bajaye Calvin cycle chalta hai. Is liye qeemat ke bawajood yeh behtareen samjhota hai.

book_ref.quote: However, in hot climates, in which photorespiration would otherwise remove more than half of the carbon fixed

blocks.prompt:
74 How do CAM plants reduce photorespiration?
(CAM plants photorespiration kaise kam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ke stomata raat ko khulte aur din mein band rehte hain. Din mein band stomata pani ka nuqsan aur CO₂ ka nikalna rokte hain, is liye zyada CO₂ photorespiration kam karti hai. Sugar ke liye CO₂ pichhli raat bane organic molecules se milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Closing stomata during the day prevents water loss and removal of CO₂

blocks.prompt:
75 Give two examples of CAM plants. Which pathways do they use?
(CAM plants ki do misalein dein. Yeh kaun se pathways istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Misalein: cactus aur pineapple (garam ilaqon ke succulent plants). C-4 plants ki tarah yeh C-4 aur C-3 dono pathways istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Like C-4 plants, these plants use both C-4 and C-3 pathways
